title: Evaluating Cross-lingual Knowledge Consistency in Code-Mixed vis-a-vis Indian Languages using IndicKLAR
abstract: arXiv:2605.29637v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Large language models often exhibit a substantial gap between their performance in English and in lower-resourced languages on equivalent knowledge queries---a cross-lingual consistency issue that remains underexplored for Indian languages and their code-mixed counterparts. To study this gap, we introduce IndicKLAR, an Indic extension of the KLAR-CLC benchmark covering 18 of the 22 scheduled Indian languages. For 11 widely used language pairs, we additionally provide code-mixed variants. Both monolingual and code-mixed inputs verified by native speakers. This three-way alignment enables us to examine how knowledge recall consistency varies across English, code-mixed, and native Indian language inputs. Across nine open-weight models, we find that the accuracy gap between native-language and English inputs can reach $\sim$0.50, while code-mixed inputs substantially reduce this gap, bringing performance within $\sim$0.05 of English with

translated_title: 使用IndicKLAR评估代码混合与印度语言之间的跨语言知识一致性
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型在同等知识查询上，其英语表现与低资源语言表现之间往往存在显著差距——这种跨语言一致性问题在印度语言及其代码混合形式上仍未得到充分研究。为了研究这一差距，我们提出了IndicKLAR，它是KLAR-CLC基准的印度语扩展版本，涵盖了印度22种表列语言中的18种。针对11种广泛使用的语言对，我们还额外提供了代码混合变体。单语和代码混合输入均经过母语使用者验证。这种三方对齐使我们能够检验知识召回一致性在英语、代码混合和印度本土语言输入之间的差异。在九个开放权重模型上，我们发现本土语言输入与英语输入之间的准确率差距可达约0.50，而代码混合输入显著缩小了这一差距，使性能与英语的差距缩小到约0.05以内。
tldr: 提出IndicKLAR基准，涵盖18种印度语言及11个语言对的代码混合变体，揭示大模型在印度本土语言与英语间的知识准确率差距可达约0.50，而代码混合输入能将该差距缩小至约0.05以内。
en_tdlr: We introduce IndicKLAR, a benchmark covering 18 Indian languages plus code-mixed variants for 11 language pairs, showing that LLMs' knowledge accuracy gap between English and Indian languages can reach ~0.50, while code-mixed inputs reduce it to within ~0.05.
